phase: Exploratory follow-up requested after aggregate results; selection fixed before reading new titles/relations

subfields.ranking: Primary equal-size k25 mean pair agreement; also preserve worst/best within-panel percentile across all 27 size/recipe/k panels on the same 183 groups
subfields.showcase_rule: Stable: highest worst percentile. Dependent: lowest best percentile. Ties by numeric Subfield ID. No universal stability threshold.

papers.population: Existing 10850 fixed query IDs in 217 Subfields, 256 candidates, ten repeats, Subfield scope
papers.ranking: Stable: largest minimum mean pair agreement across ten candidate selections. Dependent: smallest maximum. k25, ties by row_index. Preserve mean, range, k10/50, pair/model and native-search diagnostics.
papers.showcase_quality: Exclude existing strict-quality/duplicate flags for illustrated examples only; all query scores retained in full table
papers.not_generalizable: These are model-panel and candidate-universe dependent examples, not intrinsic paper quality.

relations.article_pairs: For all 10850 fixed queries and their 49 co-queries, both endpoints occur in all ten candidate samples. Report frequency among top k across ten models and ten repeats. Never count absence from candidate set as a failure. Save directed edges and per-model support.
relations.showcase: For the 12 selected papers, strongest recurrent edge and strongest encoder-dependent edge (max-minus-min per-model support), tie by mean support then row_index; retain all counterparts and actual titles/abstracts for interpretation.
relations.group_pairs: Rank each pair of matched-256 Subfield centers within each encoder using cosine; summarize rank dispersion, top5 mutual frequencies, recipe/native sensitivities where existing data permit. Separate these center relations from article neighborhood edges.
